# Recorded SIA fixtures

The original M101/comet VOTables are pinned archive research responses. `qr3_one.xml` is a
one-row, ElementTree-reserialized subset of the Barnard's Star QR3 receipt in
`docs/research/target_feasibility/metadata/barnards-star_spherex_qr3.xml`. Original column values
and INFO status are preserved; this smaller test fixture is not a complete live query response.
The source URL, retrieval time and raw response checksum are in the adjacent research receipt JSON.
